+b = anp.array([[5.0, 6.0], [7.0, 8.0]])
+q = anp.array([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]])
+
+# Define tangent vectors
+da = anp.array([[0.1, 0.2], [0.3, 0.4]])
+db = anp.array([[0.5, 0.6], [0.7, 0.8]])
+dq = anp.array([[0.9, 0.0], [0.0, 0.1]])
+
+# Function to compute the solution
+def compute_solution(a, b, q):
+    return solve_sylvester(a, b, q)
+
+# Compute Jacobian-vector products using autograd's JVP
+from autograd import make_jvp
+
+# Create a function that takes a single concatenated vector input
+def flat_solution(params):
+    # Reshape params into a, b, q matrices
+    a_flat = params[0:4]
+    b_flat = params[4:8]
+    q_flat = params[8:12]
+    
+    a = anp.reshape(a_flat, (2, 2))
+    b = anp.reshape(b_flat, (2, 2))
+    q = anp.reshape(q_flat, (2, 2))
+    
+    return anp.ravel(solve_sylvester(a, b, q))
+
+# Flatten inputs
+params = anp.concatenate([anp.ravel(a), anp.ravel(b), anp.ravel(q)])
+tangents = anp.concatenate([anp.ravel(da), anp.ravel(db), anp.ravel(dq)])
+
+# Compute JVP
+jvp_func = make_jvp(flat_solution)
+_, jvp_result = jvp_func(params)(tangents)
+
+print("JVP result (flattened):")
+print(jvp_result)
+
+# Reshape to matrix form
+jvp_matrix = anp.reshape(jvp_result, (2, 2))
+print("\nJVP result (matrix form):")
+print(jvp_matrix)
+
+# Compare with manual JVP using the _jvp_sylvester function
+# This is a bit tricky since _jvp_sylvester is not directly accessible
+# Let's manually compute what it should be:
+rhs = dq - anp.dot(da, solve_sylvester(a, b, q)) - anp.dot(solve_sylvester(a, b, q), db)

+

+import autograd.numpy as anp
+import numpy as np
+from autograd import jacobian
+from autograd.scipy.linalg import solve_sylvester
+
+# Define matrices a, b, and q
+a = anp.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]])
+b = anp.array([[5.0, 6.0], [7.0, 8.0]])
+q = anp.array([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]])
+
+# Define perturbations
+da = anp.array([[0.1, 0.2], [0.3, 0.4]])
+db = anp.array([[0.5, 0.6], [0.7, 0.8]])
+dq = anp.array([[0.9, 0.0], [0.0, 0.1]])
+
+# Function to compute the solution
+def compute_solution(a, b, q):
+    return solve_sylvester(a, b, q)
+
+# Compute Jacobians
+jac_fn_a = jacobian(compute_solution, argnum=0)
+jac_fn_b = jacobian(compute_solution, argnum=1)
+jac_fn_q = jacobian(compute_solution, argnum=2)
+
+J_a = jac_fn_a(a, b, q)
+J_b = jac_fn_b(a, b, q)
+J_q = jac_fn_q(a, b, q)
+
+# Compute directional derivatives using Jacobians
+directional_a = np.tensordot(J_a, da, axes=2)
+directional_b = np.tensordot(J_b, db, axes=2)
+directional_q = np.tensordot(J_q, dq, axes=2)
+
+print("Directional derivative w.r.t. a:")
+print(directional_a)
+print("\nDirectional derivative w.r.t. b:")
+print(directional_b)
+print("\nDirectional derivative w.r.t. q:")
+print(directional_q)
+
+# Numerical verification using finite differences
+epsilon = 1e-8
+
+sol_base = compute_solution(a, b, q)
+sol_a_pert = compute_solution(a + epsilon * da, b, q)
+sol_b_pert = compute_solution(a, b + epsilon * db, q)
+sol_q_pert = compute_solution(a, b, q + epsilon * dq)
+
+numerical_a = (sol_a_pert - sol_base) / epsilon
+numerical_b = (sol_b_pert - sol_base) / epsilon
+numerical_q = (sol_q_pert - sol_base) / epsilon
+
+print("\nNumerical derivative w.r.t. a:")
+print(numerical_a)
+print("\nNumerical derivative w.r.t. b:")
+print(numerical_b)
+print("\nNumerical derivative w.r.t. q:")
+print(numerical_q)
+
+# Check if they match (within tolerance)
+tolerance = 1e-5
+print("\nVerification (should be close to 0):")
+print("a difference:", np.max(np.abs(directional_a - numerical_a)))
+print("b difference:", np.max(np.abs(directional_b - numerical_b)))
+print("q difference:", np.max(np.abs(directional_q - numerical_q)))
+
+print("\nTest passed:", 
+      np.max(np.abs(directional_a - numerical_a)) < tolerance and
+      np.max(np.abs(directional_b - numerical_b)) < tolerance and
+      np.max(np.abs(directional_q - numerical_q)) < tolerance)
